title: Arbitrary card and core injection via SUMMON session action
rootCause: SUMMON handler in session_manager.js trusted client-supplied card object and core counts without verifying card presence in hand or removed zone
fix: Enforced strict zone verification in action_authority.js and session_manager.js; invalid or non-present cards rejected with CARD_NOT_IN_HAND; core placement verified via playCard payment plan

title: Direct resolveBattleComparison execution while Flash 2 remains active
rootCause: resolveBattleComparison in engine/response_window.js lacked verification that Flash 2 had closed with two consecutive passes
fix: Added FLASH_TIMING_NOT_CLOSED guard requiring _closedViaTwoPasses before comparison resolution, preventing comparison bypass

title: Failed PLAY_CARD operations committed and reported as successful
rootCause: session_manager.js did not check return value of playCard and proceeded to commit transaction on failure
fix: Checked result.success for PLAY_CARD and SUMMON; threw typed exceptions, triggered state rollback, and prevented event commit

title: Unknown action types accepted and committed as successful no-ops
rootCause: session_manager.js had an unwhitelisted fallthrough accepting arbitrary action types with actionResult = { success: true }
fix: Defined explicit category whitelists in action_authority.js; rejected unknown or missing action types with HTTP 400 INVALID_ACTION_TYPE

title: Unrestricted static file access exposing SQLite database and Git configuration
rootCause: server.js static file serving did not block path traversal (..), dotfiles (/.git, /.env), database files (.db, .sqlite), or internal directories
fix: Added multi-layer traversal sanitization, dotfile blocking, sensitive extension lockdown, and directory restriction to server.js

title: Server-side request forgery (SSRF) through image proxy
rootCause: image proxy endpoint accepted arbitrary external URLs and fetched them without host, IP, port, or DNS validation
fix: Enforced ALLOWED_IMAGE_DOMAINS allowlist, blocked private/loopback/cloud-metadata IPs, restricted ports to 80/443, enforced DNS checking, and limited response sizes

title: WebSocket transport-ticket authentication not preserved for subsequent operations
rootCause: WebSocket server authenticated connection ticket on connect but subsequent message handlers expected plaintext authToken in payloads
fix: Bound connectionPrincipal to WebSocket connection, allowing recordHeartbeat, submitPlayerAction, and getPlayerMatchState to operate securely without token retransmission

title: Six keyword regression test failures in keyword registry
rootCause: declareAttack unconditionally opened FLASH_1 response window blocking older direct unit tests that called declareBlock or resolveDirectHit immediately, and flow.advanceStep ignored targetStep
fix: Conditioned FLASH_1 opening on state.step === 'ATTACK' or options.useResponseWindows; fixed advanceStep to advance to targetStep
